model.bootstrap_method: 2000 resamples of entire 2025 games, seed 42; model minus baseline Brier (negative favors model). Conditional on the fitted model.
model.method: L2 logistic regression. Standardization and imputation fitted on training seasons only. L2 chosen on 2024; refit on 2023–24; 2025 untouched until evaluation.
